Most stories (s000014, s000028, s000023, s000036, s000053, s000048, s000002) resolve the issue by having Nia perform solo; s000058, s000021, s000034, and s000057 instead have Mateo write a rhythm for her; only s000017 resolves it with a private duet. These are limited branches of one shared setup, not evidence about the whole generator.
